title: CAGE / VERITAS Phase 4 Invariant Verification Matrix
specification_ref: docs/partners/VERITAS _ CAGE Phase 4 — Invariant Review Specification.pdf

invariants.title: NormativeProvider Protocol Compliance
invariants.resolution_notes: Provider03NormativeProvider implements all three canonical endpoints (fetch_baseline, validate_fria, submit_evidence) returning correctly-typed dataclasses (NormativeBaseline, ValidationResult, EvidenceSeal).

invariants.title: Fail-Closed Execution Boundary
invariants.resolution_notes: All error paths (missing endpoint, HTTPStatusError, RequestError) return admitted=False with rich ENDPOINT_ERROR findings. No execution bypass is possible.

invariants.title: ESCALATE Verdict Semantic Mapping
invariants.resolution_notes: Provider 03's ESCALATE verdict maps to CAGE's REVIEW/DEFER semantic via needs_human_review marker in findings. Admitted=False routing to DeferQueue confirmed.

invariants.title: HTTP Client Timeout Enforcement
invariants.resolution_notes: Timeout configured via PROVIDER_03_NORMATIVE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (default 5.0s) and enforced at httpx.AsyncClient construction across all endpoints.

invariants.title: Authorization Header Propagation
invariants.resolution_notes: Bearer token constructed from PROVIDER_03_NORMATIVE_API_KEY_SECRET and attached to all HTTP requests via _headers() helper.

invariants.title: JCS Canonical Hash for Bind Receipts
invariants.resolution_notes: Migrated to RFC 8785 JCS canonicalization (v3.1.0). Deterministic SHA-256 hash verified across repeated invocations.

invariants.title: Action Context Field Collision Guard
invariants.resolution_notes: Fail-closed collision detection: when action_context contains BOTH src_key and dest_key from field_map, validate_fria immediately returns admitted=False with MAPPING_COLLISION finding. HTTP dispatch is completely prevented. Value equality is irrelevant; presence of both keys violates schema determinism. Identity mappings (src_key == dest_key) correctly treated as no-op, not collision. See ADR entry in docs/partners/VERITAS_PHASE4_ALIGNMENT.md for normative fail-closed contract.

invariants.title: Defensive Payload Copy During Field Normalization
invariants.resolution_notes: Field mapping uses defensive copy (normalized_context = dict(action_context)) to preserve original payload immutability. Normalized payload constructed via spread operator to avoid mutation side effects.

invariants.title: ETag Propagation from Baseline Response
invariants.resolution_notes: NormativeBaseline.etag populated from HTTP ETag response header for cache revalidation. Falls back to empty string if header absent.

invariants.title: URL-Safe Region Encoding
invariants.test_coverage: Implicit via fetch_baseline and submit_evidence invocations with region/thread_id parameters
invariants.resolution_notes: urllib.parse.quote ensures URL-safe encoding of region and thread_id path parameters, preventing injection via special characters.

invariants.title: Rich Finding Propagation on HTTP Errors
invariants.test_coverage: tests/test_provider_03.py:311-357 (TestErrorHandling HTTP and request error tests)
invariants.resolution_notes: All HTTP errors return ValidationResult with ENDPOINT_ERROR finding containing status code, error message, and severity='blocked'. Original Provider 03 findings preserved when available.

invariants.title: JSON Decode Error Graceful Degradation
invariants.test_coverage: Implicit (error path tested via mock resp.json() exceptions)
invariants.resolution_notes: Invalid JSON responses return NormativeBaseline with error='Invalid JSON response: <exception>' instead of crashing. Prevents provider outage from cascading into gateway failure.

invariants.title: Logging at Integration Boundaries
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: src/integrations/provider_03/provider.py:54 (logger initialization), :95-99 (init logging), :132-135, :148-159 (fetch_baseline errors), :272-276, :289 (validate_fria errors), :331-334, :341 (submit_evidence errors), :354-358 (bind receipt logging)
invariants.test_coverage: Implicit via logger invocations across all error paths
invariants.resolution_notes: All HTTP errors, JSON decode failures, and bind receipt ingestions logged via 'cage.integrations.provider_03' logger with structured context (URL, status code, exception).

invariants.title: Endpoint Configuration Validation at Init
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: src/integrations/provider_03/provider.py:84 (endpoint assignment), :89-93 (warning on empty endpoint), :116-121, :172-183, :310-314 (endpoint guards in each method)
invariants.resolution_notes: Missing PROVIDER_03_NORMATIVE_ENDPOINT triggers init warning. All endpoint methods return error dataclasses (not exceptions) when endpoint unconfigured, preserving fail-closed semantics.

invariants.title: Verdict Normalization to Uppercase
invariants.resolution_notes: Provider 03 verdict strings normalized to uppercase before semantic mapping (APPROVED, ESCALATE, REJECTED), preventing case-sensitivity bugs.

invariants.title: Factory Registration Completeness
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: src/gateway/governance/normative_provider.py (factory registration, not shown in current diff)
invariants.resolution_notes: Provider 03 registered in normative provider factory. get_normative_provider('provider_03') instantiates Provider03NormativeProvider. Factory includes provider_03 in available providers list.

summary.critical_findings: I-07 (Action Context Collision Guard) required fail-closed contract addition to prevent schema determinism violations. Enforcement mechanism added at src/integrations/provider_03/provider.py:188-217.
summary.next_phase: Phase 5 Runtime Prototype — live wire integration with VERITAS decision governance endpoints and bind receipt validation.
